q1_issues.issue: The definite 'the stored mire-essence' is minted as a per-occurrence Skolem existential (sk_essence $x) with no top-level typing atom, whereas the whenever pattern anchors a definite consequent participant as a top-level constant (the dog in 'Every time the bell rings, the dog barks' gets (Member sk_dog_1 dog)), so nothing about the essence exists or is queryable until the rule fires.

notes: Rule shape, the During link, the absence of a QuantifierPhrase companion for 'whenever', the mire_essence genus with its noun modifier correctly unexposed, and the participial modifier 'stored' as (Member ... stored) all follow the instruction set. The essence is also made a function of the tending event rather than of the lantern, so two tendings of one lantern would draw distinct essences.
